en.headline: Peking opera series continues at Cultural Centre this weekend
en.dek: A youth staging of Sizhou Tanmu plays on Saturday, with a gala including Battle of Ma Chao scheduled on Sunday at the Grand Theatre.
body: A three-day Peking opera programme titled Xiangjiang Guocui Qing opened on Friday at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Grand Theatre and continues through Sunday, Xinhua and Wen Wei Po reported.

Organisers said the series is presented under the guidance of the China Peking Opera Art Foundation, jointly hosted by several cultural groups and sponsored exclusively by the Hong Kong Jockey Club. Performers are drawn from the National Peking Opera Company, the Beijing Peking Opera Theatre and the Tianjin Peking Opera Theatre, led by foundation chairman and Xi-school artist Zhang Jianguo, with Chi Xiaoqiu, Wang Yan and Tian Lei among the billed names.

Friday’s opening work was the horse-year title Hongzong Liema. Saturday’s programme is a youth version of Sizhou Tanmu; Sunday’s closing concert is due to open with the martial play Battle of Ma Chao. Deputy Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Liu Zhen was quoted by Xinhua as saying Peking opera remains popular in Hong Kong and that the visit added to the city’s cultural calendar.

The performances run at the Grand Theatre in Tsim Sha Tsui. Readers seeking seat availability and start times should check the venue’s own listings, as this desk did not independently confirm remaining ticket stock.

zh.headline: 京劇系列本周末續在文化中心上演
zh.dek: 「香江國粹情」周五揭幕，周六演青春版《四郎探母》，周日演唱會以武戲《戰馬超》開場。
body: 新華社及香港文匯報報道，「香江國粹情——2026中國京劇藝術基金會香港行」周五於香港文化中心大劇院揭幕，演出持續至周日。
主辦方表示，活動在中國京劇藝術基金會指導下，由多個文化機構聯合主辦，香港賽馬會獨家贊助。演出匯聚國家京劇院、北京京劇院及天津京劇院演員，由基金會理事長、奚派名家張建國領衔，遲小秋、王艷、田磊等亦有登台。
周五開幕劇目為馬年主題《紅鬘烈馬》；周六上演青春版《四郎探母》；周日名家名段演唱會預計以武戲《戰馬超》開場。新華社引述文化體育及旅遊局副局長劉震表示，京劇在港深受歡迎，是次活動豐富本地藝文節目。
演出地點為尖沙咀香港文化中心大劇院。餘票及開場時間以場地公布為準。
